title: Car Line Tycoon language (.clt-lang.json)
description: A language: its code, its name and texts by key. A key the file leaves out shows the English text.

format.description: The kind of file. Always this value.

formatVersion.description: The version of the format. The game reads version 1 and refuses a newer one.

gameVersion.description: The game version that wrote the file. Informative only.

name.description: The language's own name, shown in the language list.

font.description: A TTF or OTF file inside the mod folder, as a relative path. Optional.

fontLicense.description: The font's licence. Required when font is set.

entries.description: The texts, one per key. Each key at most once.

key.description: A key of the game's English table.
